key.name: style
key.description: hidden (the default): nothing (the ghost cursor still shows when the pointer is held still). ring-trail: a small ring at the anchor and a fading line to the hand. ring: just the ring. classic: the colored bars and speed badge.

key.name: color
key.description: accent: the desktop's accent color. speed: green when slow, red when fast. white: plain white.

key.name: show-speed
key.summary: Show the scroll speed next to the pointer

key.name: preview
key.summary: Bumped by the settings window to play a preview
